title: Unique projective-direction index modulo a prime
statement: Let p be a natural prime and let a, b, v be integers. Assume that p does not divide at least one of a and b, and that p does not divide v. For i in Fin(p+1), define D(i) = b − a·i.val when i.val < p, and D(i) = a·v + b·p otherwise, with all arithmetic in the integers. There exists exactly one i in Fin(p+1) such that p divides D(i).
lean_statement: ∀ (p : ℕ), p.Prime → ∀ (a b v : ℤ), (¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ a ∨ ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b) → ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ v → ∃! i : Fin (p + 1), (p : ℤ) ∣ (if i.val < p then b - a * (i.val : ℤ) else a * v + b * (p : ℤ))
